status: Implemented plain compressed-target copy/conversion/stretch without GPU compressed color attachments. Original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: Private DDraw BC1/2/3 stored-channel codec supports DXT1..5 layouts, unaligned bytes, endpoint/alpha modes, transparent BC1 and deterministic actual-color endpoints with bounded least-squares refinement. Premultiplication is a transfer policy, applied once only to newly replaced pixels.

Plain compressed-target transfers accept packed RGB20..26 or DXT1..5 sources, recover dirty CPU/GPU contents, preserve aligned same-format block bytes, snapshot overlapping allocations and use bounded floor sample maps. Unaligned partial writes decode/read-modify-encode affected blocks, preserve other valid texels and clamp only padding beyond small logical edges. Upload complete aligned storage, update content identity and retain shared retry debt after upload failure.

Keep color-fill/ROP refusals and reject keys/mirrors/clippers/unsupported public effects instead of submitting BC color attachments or silently ignoring unparsed flags. Premultiplied-to-straight compressed conversion remains refused; arbitrary palette/depth/YUV inputs remain outside the new path.

nativeReferenceReuse.scope: No new native-system XP boot in73. Reuse72 original127second system32 baseline with matching final source/executable hashes. Host-compiled actual codec matches14 native encoded blocks, actual extracted frontend matches42 pool variants and six opaque BC1->BC3 transcodes. Native blocks were not replaced by self-generated expectations.
nativeReferenceReuse.limits: The native software Blt DXT5 gradient observations differ from standard texture interpolation in12 of192 decoded samples; the exploratory comparison remains a failed exploratory run, not a pass/waiver. Stored texture decoding follows the published layout, independently checked against existing JS/GL decoding and actual GPU. Do not claim universal native software-Blit byte equivalence for arbitrary nonopaque DXT5 transfers. Eight sampled native DXT2/4->ARGB E_NOTIMPL calls remain individually recorded, no applicability waiver.

checks.scope: Actual private C codec, helper/dispatch/upload C with explicit local allocation/storage/transport substitutions. C quality fixtures are host-compiled outputs, not a claim that arbitrary floating-point endpoint refinement is bit-identical across host and XP compilers. Full original XP Wine suites exercise the real DLL. Tiny logical1/2/3 texture roots exercise host RGBA expansion; no new claim of a separate native mip-chain capture. Worker option off/on is exercised, not a claim that these FFP scenes compile programmable shaders through a worker.
checks.corrections: Initial frontend fixture compile issues (WORD typedef, missing loop brace and unused extraction) and a malformed test blue literal were fixed without changing product expectations. Initial fault controls rejected compilation or survived an overly large truncated-backing case; retain logs, strengthen to one-byte-short backing and compiled semantic controls, then all21 pass. Existing packed controls scoped to their original functions because new BC helpers repeat patterns; existing color-fill BC-attachment control adapted to the new branch while preserving its runtime assertion. Final review found unparsed public flags could reach the new plain route; added refusal gates and two public-entry fault controls. After those product edits, reran the complete92-script sweep.
